title: Forge reproduction package T5: 2*atan(u) on an Arty A7-100T, every input checked against a certified error bound
description: One function on one FPGA, and every input its certificate covers: for each of the 26,211 Q10.16 inputs of camera_fov_t5's declared domain, the part's answer is within Forge's certified error bound of 2*atan(u). The package carries the claim, the kernel's source, the program's Verilog and its library closure, a testbench, the certificate and its Lean, the bitstream, the inputs sent and the part's answers, the bench record, and the scripts that check it at three tiers (LOCAL: Python and mpmath; TOOLCHAIN: Verilator and Lean with MachLib; REPLAY: the board).
